title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
inputFormat:
Implement flattenBinaryTreeToLinkedList(root). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Trees use level-order arrays with null for missing children. The editor passes nodes with val, left, and right properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: Modify the input tree in place. The editor checks the original root after the call and displays its level-order array; return values are ignored.
